summary.short: Implementing regulation of Mexico's Ley del Sector Eléctrico, published in the DOF on 3 October 2025. It sets rules for electricity planning, permits, grid access, tariffs, user complaints, storage, clean-energy certificates and social impact authorizations for federal energy authorities and sector participants.
summary.long: Implementing regulation of Mexico's Ley del Sector Eléctrico, published in the DOF on 3 October 2025. Título Primero sets planning duties, standards and permits for generation, storage and trade, with a 60-working-day decision period and a five-year bar after revocation. Título Segundo covers energy justice, electrification and the Fondo de Servicio Universal Energético. Título Tercero regulates distributed generation, self-consumption, wholesale-market generation and mixed-development schemes. Título Cuarto covers transmission and distribution, grid access, connection contributions, metering reviews (back-billing up to ten years), complaints, maximum regulated tariffs and 48-hour outage notice. Título Quinto covers qualified users, small systems and micro-grids, market rules, clean-energy certificates, storage, electromobility and related permits. Título Sexto requires social impact authorizations before construction, with prior indigenous consultation. Penalties are largely referred to the Ley and the Ley Federal de Procedimiento Administrativo; the text provided is part 1 of 2, running to Art. 217.
